name: Akatsuki no Goei ~Principal-tachi no Kyuujitsu~
original_name: 暁の護衛～プリンシパルたちの休日～
source:
Reika and Kyouka

Kyouka Kokudou makes a sudden appearance at the Nikaidou estate one day, demanding that Kaito become her new bodyguard. This kickstarts a series of events which results in Kaito and Kyouka spending more time together. How will things end up between Reika and Kaito while Kyouka plays her game?


Tsuki

Tsuki and Kaito have something in common: neither of them can sleep in the dark. One day, Reika commands Kaito to help Tsuki, so she can eventually sleep with the lights off.

Will Tsuki be able to conquer her fears?


Aya

As Aya’s and Kaito’s relationship becomes known in the Nikaidou estate, her father Genzou quickly tries to have them both give up on it. Aya convinces him to put off the idea, but neither she nor Kaito can find a way to convince him otherwise.

It’s right then and there when Aya starts thinking about something that could maybe convince Genzou to accept Kaito once and for all.


Moe

Kaito begins his life at the Kanzaki estate, with Moe and her family. That’s when Kaito starts pondering: Moe is one year older than him, and she’ll graduate soon. What does she want to do in the future? 

Though she looked like she had no goals to him, once Kaito asks her, the answer Moe gives to him is something most unexpected…


Tae

The story picks up after Tae resolves herself to fix her lifelong partner Yuuki, who has stopped working altogether.

Her resolve is strong at first, but soon enough it begins to wane, the reason being one: Tae hates studying. Seeing this, Kaito decides to start studying more seriously to motivate her, and soon enough both will face a wall that they’ll need to climb together if they are to continue on their journey to save their friend.

[Translated from [url=http://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/goei_fd/story.html] Official Fandisk Website[/url]]
translation:
丽华与镜花

某天，国渡镜花突然现身二阶堂宅邸，要求海斗担任她的新保镖。由此引发的一连串事件，让海斗与镜花相处的时间不断增加。当镜花展开自己的谋划时，丽华与海斗之间最终会变成怎样？


月

月与海斗有一个共同点：两人都无法在黑暗中入睡。某天，丽华命令海斗帮助月，让她最终能够关灯安睡。

月能否战胜自己的恐惧？


彩

彩与海斗的关系在二阶堂宅邸公开后，她的父亲源藏立刻试图迫使两人放弃这段感情。彩说服父亲暂时搁置此事，但她与海斗都找不到办法令他改变态度。

就在此时，彩开始思考，或许有某种办法能让源藏彻底接纳海斗。


萌

海斗开始与萌及其家人在神崎宅邸共同生活。此时，他不禁思考：萌比自己年长1岁，很快就要毕业。她将来想做什么？

在海斗看来，她似乎毫无目标；然而当他开口询问时，萌给出的答案却完全出乎意料……


妙

故事从妙下定决心修好自己相伴一生、却已经完全停止运作的伙伴有希开始。

最初，她的决心十分坚定，但很快便逐渐动摇，原因只有一个：妙讨厌学习。海斗见状，决定更加认真地学习，以此激励她。不久后，两人将共同面对一道必须跨越的高墙，唯有如此才能继续拯救朋友的旅程。
